notes: CPU only: no browser frames, GPU time, live network or Render measurements.
Micro tests: 40 warmup and 120 measured calls per scale and metric; flame_frame includes real nine-tongue local flame work plus aim preview.

Matrix: two fresh rounds, 12 warmup then 60 measured ticks each. Every player fires a flame command every five ticks. Includes physics, boss, history, encoding via JSON.stringify and diagnostic instrumentation.
Matrix positions are held near a boss with very high health; damage, rays and firing cadence are unchanged. Sample windows are short and maxima are observations, not bounds.
Baseline modules come from the requested Git reference and are cleaned up on exit.
Final working-tree measurements include the identical-order unrolled slab implementation. Baseline and final variants were measured separately without browser/build load.

notes: Two real headless Chrome tabs with full game renderers on a local Socket.IO server; four measured seconds after two warmup seconds.

Flame mode: two stationary players hold fire towards a normal/grown Warden (or empty lane). Lethal counterattack starts a real slash just before its contact window, followed by real respawn and a stale-life event fixture.
Local CPU/GPU contention from two renderers affects frame timing; results do not represent Render or Internet latency.
Transport fixture applies 0/100/250ms RTT with reliable ordered 35ms jitter bursts on both directions (no jitter at RTT zero).
correction measures authoritative reconciliation displacement; backwardFrames counts camera x decreases exceeding 0.001 units.

lifecycle.killed.deaths[].deadStateFrameMs measures receipt until an animation-frame observer sees the dead state; it excludes DOM/GPU presentation. combat.deathFeedback_ms measures receipt through production render submission.
